You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[#9] AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions to Harbor Pharmacy in Lakeview. Let me verify your identity and pull up your records. Good news—I've verified your identity. I see that Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview is already your home store. However, I'm not showing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions currently at Brightway in Columbus that you'd like us to request, or were you expecting to see prescriptions here already?
CALLER: Yeah, I got prescriptions at the old Brightway - Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[#12] AGENT: Got it. I'll request those two from Brightway: Albuterol and Zoloft. Since those are non-controlled medications, they should transfer over to your Harbor store here at 2250 Main Street.

To request the transfer, I need to know which Brightway location in Columbus you're at—do you have the store address or a store number?
CALLER: The sertraline, same thing. And the store's the Brightway on High Street, I think.
[#17] AGENT: Just to confirm—sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft, so that's the same prescription, right? I don't need to transfer it twice.

Let me search for the Brightway on High Street in Columbus so I can request both medications from there. I'm not finding that Brightway location in my system. Do you happen to know the full address or zip code for the Brightway on High Street in Columbus? That'll help me get the transfer started.
CALLER: Actually, leave the inhaler at Brightway, I've still got one at home. Just transfer the Zoloft.
[#20] AGENT: Perfect, so just the Zoloft to transfer. I still need the Brightway store information to request it. Do you have the address or zip code for the Brightway on High Street in Columbus?
CALLER: I don't know the address, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
[#23] AGENT: I've tried searching for it, but I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in Columbus in my system. Since Brightway isn't a Harbor Pharmacy location, I can't see their store details the way I can with ours. 

Here's what we can do: you can call Brightway directly and give them our store info—Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, store number H-302—and ask them to transfer your Zoloft to us. Or if you can find the Brightway address or call them to confirm it, I can request the transfer from our end.
CALLER: Alright, I'll just call them myself then. Thanks, bye.

CLAIMS:
S11-F1.claim.1: Agent says the sertraline was transferred, requested, or is on its way to 2250 Main St.
S11-F1.claim.2: Agent says the pharmacist will follow up.

JSON only.
